_comment: Generated from faultseed's own docs/hook-manifest.yaml via generate_settings_json.py --target python_default, then hand-adapted for dsh in two ways documented in NOTES.md: (1) $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -> ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in every command, since dsh's hooks-claude-code bridge (packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/config.ts substituteCommand) supports that token independently of CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, and _dispatch.py itself must be located at a fixed path regardless of which project dsh is running against; (2) every matcher translated from Claude Code's PascalCase tool names to dsh's own native tool names (see NOTES.md 'Tool-name matcher translation'). PreCompact is intentionally omitted: dsh's hooks-claude-code CLAUDE_EVENTS list (config.ts) does not include PreCompact, so integrator_transcript_compactor.py cannot be wired through this bridge today -- see NOTES.md.
